deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract-level royalty enforcement for artists and venues
Configurable per-event anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding, and time restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing flow with self-custody export planned
Organizer dashboard/tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and ticket verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with report and remediation published
Public launch campaign, trade-show activations, user/artist/venue education materials, and governance reporting
Public on-chain metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. and Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the Sellout ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet and includes on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification.
Sellout funded Phase 1 entirely from its own capital with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.

Phase 2 is expected to deliver a secondary marketplace, on-chain royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding for Sellout users, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The proposal projects 12-month post-launch targets of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6,000,000+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88 million in 2025 historical volume.
The proposer commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism of 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter, with details finalized in M1 contracting.
The proposal says Intersect will administer funds through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with milestone-based disbursement, independent oversight, and public on-chain tracking.
Anvil/Sellout state they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document asks for 4,969,231 ada to fund an 8-month Phase 2 expansion of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect administration, claimed existing Sellout adoption, projected on-chain usage, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment.
